provenance.generation: Lossless selected original published computational-data projection; no synthetic numerical observations. Source captures identify the original bytes. Any derived coordinate or format metadata is explicitly marked. These are computational inputs,not new experimental measurements.
provenance.units: Original gamma J/m^2;unit normals dimensionless;support distances proportional to gamma in an arbitrary common positive shape scale
provenance.derived_coordinate_metadata: For this supplied cubic phase,all distinct signed permutations of every original hkl are converted to unit normals in the source cubic Cartesian axes. Orientation completion retains original energy and reconstruction flag without computing morphology.
provenance.scope: Only supplied clean PBE-DFT surface families are considered. This restricted model does not establish all real low-energy faces,finite-temperature morphology or kinetic growth shapes.
